title: API key
description: One personal API key as GET /api/v1/keys lists it (hlm key list). Never the key itself or its hash.

kind.description: Actor of the key's changes: cli (the user at a terminal) or agent

scope.description: read: only reads; write: also changes tasks and settings; full: also the account (keys, webhooks, devices, connections, calendar feed)

expiresAt.description: When the key stops working, Unix milliseconds; null: never

revokedAt.description: Unix milliseconds; null while the key is not revoked

createdWith.description: Id of the key that created this one (it stops with that key); null for keys made in the app or by the admin
